picks.title: Can AI Make a Sci-Fi Series for $38,000? Artlist's 'The Arc' Puts It to the Test
picks.excerpt: Artlist's AI-made sci-fi series 'The Arc' tests whether generative tools can deliver a watchable series on a $38,000 budget.
picks.rationale: A concrete production with a stated budget ($38K for a series). It gives creators a cost benchmark for AI episodic work, and the craft piece is distinct from the 10-12 'Overstake' rebuild.

picks.title: FilmFest Cottbus selects AI-generated feature 'A Woman Asleep' for main competition
picks.excerpt: Vikki Bardot's AI-generated feature 'A Woman Asleep' is one of 10 films in FilmFest Cottbus' main competition, a festival-selection milestone for AI features.
picks.rationale: A follow-up with a new concrete event: an established festival placed an AI-generated feature in its main competition, which is a gatekeeping milestone beyond the 09-26 distribution deal.

picks.title: Here's how Hollywood is Directing Their AI Films
picks.excerpt: Curious Refuge and Albert Bozesan show an AI camera-control workflow: Claude drives Blender to block shots that guide AI video generation.
picks.rationale: The most actionable item in the pool: a reproducible workflow (an LLM drives Blender blocking, which then guides AI video) that a filmmaker can try tomorrow.

picks.title: 'IvyBears' Hits Cannes After YouTube Breakout, Spawns Animated Feature Project
picks.excerpt: IvyBears goes brand-to-content with a series and an animated feature project, in a 'reverse flywheel' approach powered by AI and artists alike.
picks.rationale: A new business model: a YouTube brand built with AI and artists moves up into a series and a feature at MIPCOM. It shows a viable path from AI-assisted short-form to long-form IP.

picks.title: Tech Reviews: Gaomon PD1561 V2, Foundry SmartRoto, Huion Kamvas Pro 24
picks.excerpt: Monthly animation/VFX tech review covering Foundry's AI-assisted SmartRoto Nuke add-on for rotoscoping alongside two pen displays.
picks.rationale: A hands-on review of Foundry's AI-assisted SmartRoto for Nuke. Rotoscoping is a daily VFX chore, so this is directly tool-actionable. The enrichment pass should center the card on SmartRoto, not the pen displays.

alternates.title: Fan Bingbing Says Young Chinese Audiences 'Aren't Being Fed Very Well' as AI Microdramas Boom
alternates.excerpt: At Busan, Fan Bingbing questioned the value of the booming AI-generated microdrama format for Chinese audiences.
alternates.rationale: Alternate: a star's commentary on AI microdramas. It is new, but it is opinion and 9 days old.

https://www.screendaily.com/news/filmfes.new_action: FilmFest Cottbus officially selected 'A Woman Asleep' for its 10-film main competition. This is a new festival-selection announcement, separate from the 09-26 Baska Sinema theatrical-distribution deal.
